## Why this list

| | |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🎚️ **Level on every row** | Senior, Staff+ or Mid — the seniority the loop was reported at, so an L6 candidate is not reading new-grad OAs. |
| 🧭 **Round on every row** | OA, phone screen, onsite or take-home: practise for the round you actually have next. |
| 🔬 **Research & quant tracks** | ML engineer, research scientist and quant researcher/developer questions, cut out of the bank instead of buried in it. |
| 🔥 **Fresh, automatically** | Synced from the live catalog every hour; 🔥 and 🆕 expire on their own, so the top of every list is what is being asked now. |
| ▶ **Runnable, not a screenshot** | Every title opens the real problem in an editor; coding, OOD and SQL get a judged verdict. **Free** rows open without a paid plan. |
| 📦 **Data, not just markdown** | [`data/questions.csv`](data/questions.csv) and [`data/questions.jsonl`](data/questions.jsonl): every row with its companies, round, level and role. |

## Contribute

Saw a question in an OA or a loop? [**Submit it**](https://github.com/kevin-2023-code/Tech-OA-Questions/issues/new?template=oa-report.yml) — company, role, level, round and a short source-safe summary. No screenshots, no copied problem statements: see [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Rows are generated from the catalog, so please do not open a pull request against a table.

**Built something on the data?** A study planner, a Discord bot, a chart — open an issue with the link and we will list it here. [`data/questions.csv`](data/questions.csv) and [`data/questions.jsonl`](data/questions.jsonl) carry every row with its companies, round, level and role, refreshed hourly.
